verdict.rationale: Synthesia documents a Video API that generates finished videos at scale, including avatar videos, dubbing, translation and templates. An Upload API supplies assets, webhooks signal completion, and time-limited download links return the .mp4, so the whole pipeline can run headlessly from scripts with no UI. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-specific integration docs/examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of automated pipeline use.
